sampler.selection_rule: Sort PILOT_TRAIN Easy records by sequence family, geometry_generation_seed, then geometry_id; choose 3 SCCS, 3 SCSS and 2 SCS.
sampler.environment_seed_rule: SHA256(train_env_seed:{training_root_seed}:{episode_index}) first 32 bits modulo 1000000; sampler episode index begins at 1.

diagnostic.conditional_50000_full_episode_rule: Run if mean 300-step route_progress_delta >= 0.02, mean stationary_fraction <= 0.90, and no safety failure is observed in that checkpoint's fixed probe.

only_registered_arm_difference: fixed post-encoder group-wise physical unit scaling in pilot_groupwise_physical_v1; frozen 409D encoder contract remains unchanged

early_transfer_rule.action: Stop Easy-only learnability campaign at the qualifying checkpoint; do not start multi-map training.

resume_policy: No partial run will be silently resumed. If interrupted without all state restored and tested, preserve it as incomplete and do not concatenate a new segment.
